ios.desc:
Understand what your body needs today.

Livity turns data from Apple Health, Apple Watch, Garmin, Fitbit, and Oura into clear insights for recovery, training readiness, sleep, strain, stress, and energy. See whether to push, maintain, or rest — and understand why.

WHAT YOU GET
• Recovery and readiness scores based on HRV, resting heart rate, sleep, and recent training
• Sleep stages, restorative sleep, sleep debt, and overnight trends
• Training load, strain, heart-rate zones, routes, splits, and sport-specific insights
• Stress, energy, fitness age, and long-term biometric trends
• An AI health coach grounded in your data
• Fast food, water, journal, habit, and blood-report tracking
• Home Screen widgets, Apple Watch complications, and 100+ achievements

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Core health calculations happen on your device. You choose which optional integrations and AI features to use.

Livity works with Apple Health and can connect to Garmin, Fitbit, and Oura. It is designed for wellness and fitness insights, not medical diagnosis.

Train with purpose. Recover with confidence. Sleep better.

quotes.text: Hello everyone! Please meet Livity - A free app that translates Apple Watch collected data and presents it understandably! It calculates Your sleep, recovery, and strain scores and gives You suggestions on how to improve it! So far it works only with Apple Watches. Please let me know how the test ride goes, and I'm waiting for all the feedback!
